testCases.title: Reject onboarding application missing mandatory food safety license number
testCases.steps: 1. Leave FSSAI / Safety License blank 2. Submit
testCases.expected: Validation error: "Food Safety License number is mandatory."

testCases.title: Admin Portal displays pending restaurant partner requests in verification queue
testCases.expected: Displays pending requests with Approve and Reject action buttons

testCases.title: Admin approval transitions restaurant to approved_restaurants table
testCases.expected: Status changes to "Approved"; restaurant listed in public discovery

testCases.title: Approved restaurant receives automated onboarding confirmation email
testCases.expected: Confirmation email dispatched to partner owner via Resend API

testCases.title: Partner portal allows merchant to upload and manage menu items with macros
testCases.expected: Dish created with Price, Ingredients, Nutri-Score, and Diet tags

testCases.title: Reject menu item with negative price or zero calories
testCases.expected: Validation error blocks submission

testCases.title: Merchant can toggle dish availability status (In Stock / Sold Out)
testCases.expected: Status switches to "Sold Out"; dish hidden from public recommendation

testCases.title: Public restaurant discovery page displays verified partner badge
testCases.expected: Displays green checkmark "Verified FoodieBite Partner" badge

testCases.title: Filter partner restaurants by cuisine (North Indian, Italian, Asian, Mexican)
testCases.expected: Results restricted exclusively to North Indian restaurant partners

testCases.title: Restaurant details page displays full menu, opening hours, and location map
testCases.expected: Displays address, interactive map link, hours, and categorized menu

testCases.title: External MealMe deep link on restaurant page opens direct delivery order page
testCases.expected: Opens MealMe order link in new tab with pre-selected item

testCases.title: Merchant portal dashboard displays daily order and recommendation clicks
testCases.expected: Displays Total Menu Views, Item Clicks, and Recommendation Referral count

testCases.expected: Merchant session terminated; redirected to partner landing page
